운동장.x: The kids are playing soccer on the field.
운동장.e: 운동 (exercise) + 장 (ground). -장 = place, as in 수영장 (swimming pool).

머리.x: I've had a headache since yesterday.
머리.t: 머리 often means hair: 머리를 잘랐어요 = I got a haircut. 머리가 좋다 = smart.

올라가다.x: I go up to the third floor by the stairs.
올라가다.e: 오르다 (rise) + 가다 (go); 올라오다 = come up. Opposite: 내려가다.
올라가다.t: Also used for going up to Seoul from other regions: 서울에 올라가요.

안개.ex: 아침에 안개가 많이 껴서 앞이 잘 안 보여요.
안개.x: There's so much fog this morning that I can't see ahead well.

맛집.m: great place to eat, popular restaurant
맛집.x: There's a famous restaurant near here.

실수.ex: 처음에는 누구나 실수를 할 수 있어요.
실수.x: Anyone can make mistakes at first.
실수.e: Literally 'lose hold with the hand' — a slip of the hand.

달라지다.ex: 오랜만에 고향에 가 보니 많이 달라졌어요.
달라지다.x: When I visited my hometown after a long time, it had changed a lot.

전문.x: This restaurant specializes in Korean food.
전문.t: X 전문 means 'specializing in X' and is common on shop signs.

치료.x: I got a lot better after receiving treatment.

전세.m: jeonse (a lease paid with one large deposit instead of monthly rent)
전세.x: We found a small apartment on a jeonse lease.
전세.e: A Korean system: you pay a big deposit, live rent-free, and get it back when you leave.
전세.t: A different 전세 means 'charter,' as in 전세 버스 'chartered bus.'

출연.m: appearance (on TV, in a film or show)
출연.ex: 그 배우의 영화 출연 소식이 뉴스에 나왔어요.
출연.x: News of that actor appearing in a movie came out.
출연.t: Pronounced [추련]: the ㄹ batchim links to the next vowel.

인구.ex: 서울의 인구는 천만 명이 조금 안 돼요.
인구.x: Seoul's population is a little under ten million.
인구.e: Literally 'people mouths' — counting the mouths to feed.

발전하다.m: to develop, to progress, to advance
발전하다.ex: 요즘 기술이 아주 빠르게 발전하고 있어요.
발전하다.x: Technology is advancing very quickly these days.

토론하다.x: The students debated the death penalty.
토론하다.t: Use N에 대해 토론하다 for 'to debate about N'.

메모.x: Jot down the important points so you don't forget.
메모.e: From English 'memo'; 메모하다 means 'to jot down', not to send an office memo.
메모.t: 메모를 남기다 means 'to leave a note' for someone.

맞추다.m: to fit, to adjust, to match; to set (an alarm); to put together
맞추다.x: I set an alarm so I can get up early tomorrow.
맞추다.e: Related to 맞다 'to fit, to be right': to make things fit.
맞추다.t: For guessing a correct answer, standard Korean uses 맞히다: 정답을 맞히다.

연결되다.m: to be connected, to be linked; to get through (on the phone)
연결되다.x: The phone isn't getting through right now.
연결되다.t: Spell the contraction 됐어요 (from 되었어요), never 됬어요.

시도하다.x: I tried a new dish over the weekend.

본격적.x: Summer starts in earnest next week.
본격적.e: Literally 'by the real standard' — doing it properly now.
본격적.t: Pronounced [본껵쩍]; 본격적으로 시작하다 'to really get started' is the key collocation.

다수.x: We decided to follow the majority's opinion.

경쟁률.x: This university's competition rate this year was ten to one.
경쟁률.t: Pronounced [경쟁뉼]; ratios are read with 대: 10대 1 'ten to one'.

제조.ex: 이 공장에서는 자동차 부품 제조를 합니다.

의료.ex: 한국은 의료 서비스가 빠르고 편리한 편이에요.
의료.x: Korea's medical services are fairly fast and convenient.
의료.t: Mostly used before another noun: 의료 보험, 의료 기관, 의료비.

여론.ex: 새 정책에 대한 여론이 좋지 않습니다.
여론.x: Public opinion on the new policy is not good.

처벌.ex: 음주 운전에 대한 처벌이 더 강해졌어요.
처벌.x: The punishment for drunk driving has become stricter.
처벌.t: For wrongdoers, 처벌을 받다 means 'to be punished.'

이혼하다.x: That actor got divorced after two years of marriage.
이혼하다.e: Literally 'leave the marriage'; the opposite of 결혼.

양성평등.ex: 양성평등을 위해 여러 가지 제도가 만들어졌어요.
양성평등.x: Various systems have been created to promote gender equality.

명백히.x: This accident is clearly the company's responsibility.
명백히.e: Literally 'bright and white': plain as day.
명백히.t: Pronounced [명배키]; used for facts beyond doubt, like evidence or responsibility.

염려하다.x: My parents always worry about my health.
염려하다.t: Pronounced [염녀하다]; more formal than 걱정하다, as in 염려하지 마세요.

헐다.forms: 헐어요 · 헐었어요 · 헐 거예요 · 허세요 (ㄹ drops)
헐다.m: to demolish, pull down; to dip into (savings); to wear out; to get sores (skin)
헐다.x: Something urgent came up, so I broke into my savings.
헐다.t: 입안이 헐다 means to get mouth sores.

뒤늦다.x: I realized my mistake late and apologized to my friend.
뒤늦다.e: Built from 뒤 'behind' + 늦다 'late' — late, after the right moment.
뒤늦다.t: Mostly used as 뒤늦게 (belatedly): 뒤늦게 알다, 뒤늦게 깨닫다.

활기.x: The morning market is bustling with people.

절친.x: She's been my best friend since high school.
절친.e: Short for 절친한 친구 'very close friend'.
절친.t: Casual. Similar words: 베프 (from 'best friend') and the slang 찐친 'real friend'.

단톡방.x: My old classmates and I made a new group chat.
단톡방.t: Pronounced [단톡빵]. Casual, often just 단톡. Leaving one is 단톡방을 나가다.

연임.ex: 그 대표는 연임에 성공해 4년 더 일하게 되었습니다.
연임.x: The chairperson won a second term and will serve four more years.
연임.t: Korean presidents serve a single five-year term, so presidential 연임 is not allowed.

소관.m: jurisdiction, area of responsibility (of a department)
소관.x: That issue falls under the Ministry of Education.
소관.t: Pattern: N 소관이다 = it's N's job; 소관 is a duty area, 관할 more a territory or authority.

대담.x: Today a conversation with a famous author will be broadcast.
대담.t: Homonym: 대담하다 (大膽) means 'to be bold, daring'.

심화되다.m: to deepen, to intensify, to worsen
심화되다.ex: 도시와 농촌 간의 격차가 점점 심화되고 있습니다.
심화되다.x: The gap between cities and rural areas is gradually widening.

규탄하다.e: Literally 'probe and attack' — publicly condemning wrongdoing.
규탄하다.t: Common in protest slogans and official statements: 규탄 대회 is a protest rally.

첨예하다.ex: 이 문제를 두고 두 나라의 의견이 첨예하게 대립하고 있어요.
첨예하다.x: The two countries are sharply divided over this issue.
첨예하다.e: Literally 'pointed and sharp' — used for conflicts, not objects.
첨예하다.t: The classic phrase is 첨예하게 대립하다 'to be sharply opposed'.

지피지기.m: knowing the enemy and knowing oneself
지피지기.x: Know your enemy and yourself and you'll win every battle, so let's study the other team first.
지피지기.e: Literally 'know them, know yourself' — from Sun Tzu's The Art of War.
지피지기.t: Usually in the full saying 지피지기면 백전백승.

겨를.m: spare time, a moment to spare
겨를.ex: 일이 너무 많아서 밥 먹을 겨를도 없어요.
겨를.x: I have so much work I don't even have time to eat.
겨를.t: Almost always negative: V-ㄹ 겨를이 없다 'to have no time to V'.

본심.ex: 그 사람은 웃고 있었지만 본심을 알 수가 없었어요.
본심.x: He was smiling, but I couldn't tell what he really felt.

섬유.x: Daegu has long been famous for its textile industry.
섬유.t: Also means dietary fiber, as in 섬유질 or 식이섬유.

간호.x: My mother cared for my sick younger sibling all night.
간호.t: 간호 is professional or family nursing care; 간병 stresses day-to-day bedside caregiving.

이해관계.ex: 이 문제는 여러 나라의 이해관계가 얽혀 있어요.
이해관계.x: Several countries' interests are tangled up in this issue.
이해관계.t: Don't confuse 이해(利害) 'interests' with 이해(理解) 'understanding'; context tells them apart.

은어.m: slang, jargon, secret language of a group
은어.e: Literally 'hidden words', understood only inside a group.
은어.t: Homonym warning: 은어 is also the fish 'sweetfish'; context makes it clear.

안전자산.ex: 불안할 때는 금 같은 안전자산의 가격이 올라요.
안전자산.x: In uncertain times, the price of safe assets like gold goes up.
안전자산.e: Literally 'safe assets' — gold, bonds or dollars that hold value in a crisis.

행정명령.ex: 대통령이 이민과 관련된 새로운 행정명령에 서명했어요.
행정명령.x: The president signed a new executive order on immigration.
행정명령.t: Pronounced [행정명녕] — ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

옴부즈맨.ex: 시민들은 옴부즈맨에게 행정에 대한 불만을 제기할 수 있어요.
옴부즈맨.x: Citizens can raise complaints about administration with the ombudsman.
옴부즈맨.e: From English 'ombudsman', originally a Swedish word; Korean drops the 'd' sound.

현세.m: this world, this life, the present world
현세.ex: 그 종교는 내세보다 현세의 행복을 더 중요하게 여겨요.
현세.x: That religion values happiness in this life more than the afterlife.
현세.t: Formal word; in everyday speech people say 이승 (this world) versus 저승 (the next).

뇌경색.x: The sooner a cerebral infarction is treated, the fewer the aftereffects.
뇌경색.e: Literally 'brain blocked up' — a vessel in the brain is clogged.

완화의료.ex: 완화의료는 환자의 고통을 줄이는 데 중점을 둡니다.
완화의료.x: Palliative care focuses on reducing the patient's suffering.
완화의료.e: Literally 'easing medical care' — soothing, not curing.

설비투자.ex: 반도체 회사들이 올해 설비투자를 크게 늘렸습니다.
설비투자.x: Chip companies sharply increased their capital investment this year.

단절되다.m: to be cut off, to be severed, to be disconnected
단절되다.ex: 폭설로 그 마을과의 교통이 완전히 단절되었습니다.
단절되다.x: Heavy snow completely cut off transportation to the village.
단절되다.t: Useful phrases: 세대 단절 'generational disconnect' and 경력 단절 'career break'.

일말.m: a trace, a touch, a shred (of)
일말.x: I wish he had at least a shred of conscience.
일말.e: Literally 'one brushstroke': just a faint trace.
일말.t: Fixed pattern: 일말의 희망/양심/기대 'a shred of hope/conscience/expectation'.

조간.ex: 그 소식은 오늘 조간에 크게 실렸습니다.
조간.x: That news ran prominently in this morning's papers.
조간.e: Short for 조간신문 'morning newspaper'; the opposite is 석간 'evening paper'.

추서하다.m: to confer posthumously (a rank or decoration)
추서하다.x: The government posthumously awarded a medal to the firefighter who died on duty.
추서하다.e: Literally 'confer afterward' — honoring someone after death.
rel: death in the line of duty

반포지효.m: filial devotion; repaying one's parents' care
반포지효.ex: 부모님을 모시고 사는 그의 반포지효에 감동했어요.
반포지효.x: I was moved by his devotion in caring for his parents.
반포지효.e: Young crows are said to feed their aging parents in return.

말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.forms: 말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다더니 · 말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶은 법이에요
말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.m: the more you get, the more you want (lit. once on a horse, you want someone to lead it by the reins)
말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.ex: 말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다더니, 월급이 오르니까 이제 차도 바꾸고 싶어요.
말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.x: The more you get, the more you want: now that my salary went up, I want a new car too.
말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.e: Once you are riding a horse, you want a servant to hold the reins and lead it (경마 잡히다). This 경마 comes from 견마 (牽馬) 'leading a horse', not 경마 (競馬) 'horse racing'.
말 타면 경마 잡히고 싶다.t: Pronounced [말 타면 경마 자피고 십따]. Describes how desires keep growing once one wish is met; often said self-mockingly.
nb: 열 길 물속은 알아도 한 길 사람 속은 모른다
